_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Facilities Plan
summary: The Facilities Plan identifies and describes all existing and proposed facilities required to support stated requirements and is used in preparing the military construction program.
description_purpose:
The Facilities Plan identifies and describes all existing and proposed facilities which are required to support stated requirements.
The plan is used in the preparation of the military construction program.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
This DID supersedes DI-P-1618.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Facilities Plan format shall be contractor selected. Unless effective presentation would be degraded, the initially used format arrangement shall be used for all subsequent submissions.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Facilities Plan shall contain chapters covering the following subjects:

children.title: General discussion including purpose, authority, background information, and approval concept
Real property facilities items.
children.content: Each chapter, other than chapter 1, shall contain a list of real property facilities items, including land requirements, followed by a separate page for each of the following items:

children.title: Project title and number or other method of identification.
Identification of whether technical support real property or non-technical support real property.
Brief description of functions to be performed and equipment and personnel to be accommodated.
Interrelationship with other facility requirements and why required.
Identification of any requirements necessitating further special studies.
General schedules after design, construction, and equipment delivery including lead time.
Type of construction including any special consideration, i.e., shock, hardness, etc.
Bibliography and glossary.
children.content: The Facilities Plan shall contain a bibliography and a glossary at the end of the last chapter.
